{{Quote|Good luck, General.|[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] to [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]] before the ''Separatist Nightmare'' departs|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
The '''''Separatist Nightmare''''' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]]. The ''Nightmare'' had its name painted in [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] on the both sides of its nose, along with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] painted to look like a [[Human/Legends|Human]] skull. In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], when the Republic launched a full-scale attack on the Separatist stronghold [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], the ''Nightmare'' served as a troop transport during the [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|battle]]. The ''Nightmare'' carried [[High Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], as well as several [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], during a large aerial assault on the Separatists' [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|main droid factory]]. However, the ''Nightmare'' and several other gunships were shot down by Separatist [[Flak gun/Legends|flak guns]] before it could reach the Republic's planned landing point, forcing it to crash-land. The gunship was utterly ruined by the landing, but Mundi and a few of his troopers were able to survive and pull themselves out of the ''Nightmare''{{'s}} wreckage.

==Description==
{{Quote|The flak's too heavy.|Mundi right before the ''Nightmare'' is shot down|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
[[File:SeparatistNightmareLogo-LaPR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|''Separatist Nightmare'' nose art]]
The ''Separatist Nightmare'' was a [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry]] [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]],<ref name="LaPR" /> manufactured by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]],<ref name="CCS" /> that was used by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. The ''Nightmare'' had customized nose art on either of its sides, with a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper's]] [[Armor/Legends|helmet]] painted to look like a skull, as well as its name written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|aurebesh]] next to the helmet.<ref name="EpGuide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode205.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Landing at Point Rain}}</ref> The gunship had a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] large enough to hold a [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone pilot]], two anti-personnel [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turrets at the front of the vessel, two rear [[Engine/Legends|engines]], and four [[composite-beam laser]] turrets, two of which were at either side of the ''Nightmare'' and the other two built-into both of the gunship's wings. The ''Nightmare'' had a passenger compartment in the center of the ship that was large enough to hold several grown [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] and a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]]. Although the ''Nightmare'' was well armored, it could not withstand continuous fire from enemy [[Flak gun/Legends|flak guns]].<ref name="LaPR" />

==History==
{{Quote|We got hit pretty hard.|Commander Jet after the ''Separatist Nightmare'' was shot down|<ref name="LaPR" />}}
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="TCWn">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (novelization)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' novelization]]</ref> the Republic discovered that the Confederacy had reactivated its [[Geonosis droid factories/Legends|battle-droid factories]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], which the Republic had previously deactivated at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start of the war]]. The Republic decided to launch a [[Second Battle of Geonosis/Legends|full-scale assault]] on Geonosis, sending a large Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]]&mdash;which the ''Separatist Nightmare'' was a part of&mdash;to conquer the Separatist stronghold. The Republic task force planned to launch a large, three-pronged aerial attack against the well-defended [[Geonosis primary droid foundry/Legends|main Confederate droid foundary]].<ref name="LaPR" />

[[File:SeparatistNightmareHit-LandingAtPointRain.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The ''Separatist Nightmare'' is hit by enemy fire.]]
In the plan, the ''Separatist Nightmare'', alongside many other gunships, would transport [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Ki-Adi-Mundi/Legends|Ki-Adi-Mundi]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone Commander]] [[Jet/Legends|Jet]], and several other clone troopers across the Confederacy's central defense perimeter and land at a rendezvous point, before continuing the attack on the foundary. At the start of the battle, the ''Nightmare'', with its passengers aboard, launched from a Republic [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] and began its assault along with the other Republic transports as planned.<ref name="LaPR" />

However, the Republic's aerial offensive was met by a well-prepared Separatist counterattack. As the ''Nightmare'' approached the Confederate defense line, the gunship's left wing was hit by fire from Separatist [[Flak/Legends|flak]] guns, heavily damaging the ''Nightmare''. The vessel and several other damaged gunships were forced to crash-land a distance from the Republic's planned landing point. The ''Nightmare'' was almost completely destroyed by the landing, and many of its passengers and crew were [[Death/Legends|killed]], but [[General/Legends|General]] Mundi, Jet, and a few other troopers survived and managed to pull themselves out of the gunship's wreckage.<ref name="LaPR" />

==Crew==
The ''Separatist Nightmare'' was flown by a clone [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], as well as a clone co-pilot, who operated the gunship's wing [[Particle beam/Legends|particle-beam]] turrets. The vessel also had a pair of [[Clone gunner/Legends|clone gunners]] that operated either of gunship's side beam turrets. During the Second Battle of Geonosis, the ''Nightmare'' was used to transport several clone troopers&mdash;including clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Jet&mdash;and [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Ki-Adi-Mundi. After it was shot down, many of the ''Nightmare''{{'s}} passengers were killed, but Mundi and Jet managed to survive the crash-landing.<ref name="LaPR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Separatist Nightmare''{{'s}} first and only appearance was in "[[Landing at Point Rain]],"<ref name="LaPR" /> the fifth episode in [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|Season Two]] of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. In the episode, the gunship had its nose art put in as an [[Easter egg (virtual)|easter egg]], which the "Landing at Point Rain" episode guide later pointed out.<ref name="EpGuide" />

In a continuity error, when the ''Nightmare'' departs the assault ship, the outside of the cockpit is green, but later, it is red.<ref name="LaPR" />
